powers.action_summary: Enact and enforce ordinances making alarm companies pay false alarm fines, only when the false alarm is attributed to the alarm system or company error.
powers.quote: a municipality may enact, adopt or enforce any ordinance, resolution or regulation requiring any alarm system company to pay for or be responsible for any fines, fees or other penalties relative to false alarms only when the false alarm is attributed to a deficiency in the alarm system or an error of the alarm system company or central station.
powers.law_title: Relates to fines for false alarms by an alarm system

powers.action_summary: Authorize and undertake 12 phase three school modernization projects in the city of Rochester up to a total cost of $600 million.
powers.quote: (c) 12 projects, up to a total cost of six hundred million dollars in phase three shall be authorized and undertaken pursuant to this act, unless otherwise authorized by law.
affected_groups: students of the city school district of the city of Rochester
powers.law_title: Relates to the Rochester school facilities modernization program act

powers.actor_raw: the assessor of the town of Brookhaven
powers.action_summary: Accept an application from St. Mary AME Zion Church for a real property tax exemption for the 2022-2023 through 2024-2025 assessment rolls.
powers.quote: the assessor of the town of Brookhaven is hereby authorized to accept from the St. Mary AME Zion Church an application for exemption from real property taxes pursuant to section 420-a of the real property tax law
powers.law_title: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from St. Mary AME Zion Church

powers.action_summary: Grant the exemption and correct the rolls, upon approval of the town board, if the church would otherwise have been entitled to it.
powers.quote: the assessor, upon approval of the town of Brookhaven town board, may grant exemption from taxation on such assessment rolls and make the appropriate corrections of the subject rolls.
powers.law_title: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from St. Mary AME Zion Church

powers.action_summary: Continue to impose a hotel and motel tax under chapter 469 of the laws of 2024, with the authority now expiring September 1, 2027.
powers.quote: This act shall take effect immediately and shall expire September 1, 2027, when upon such date the provisions of this act shall be deemed repealed therewith.
powers.law_title: Extends the city of Olean's authority to impose a hotel and motel tax
